def transform(grid):
    """Stamp the colored mask onto every translation whose cells are holes (0)."""

    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = {v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0, background)}
    if not colors:
        return g
    color = colors.pop()
    shape = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
